title: Triage run
description: One triage run over one raw entry (raw capture and triage design, docs/design/RAW_TRIAGE_2026-11-09.md), at raw/triage/<id>.json (route raw/triage/[id]). It keeps every question Jev (TypeSafe System 1) was asked, its answer as a probability, the model, the line the run used, what was filed and what was held for a person. Code decides from the answers (packages/naive/src/engine/triage.ts); no answer is ever a decision on its own. Written once per run and never edited: a person's correction resolves a trial of the triage-accept detector instead.

id.description: The run's id, the file name without .json

entry.description: The raw entry triaged, as a venture path: raw/dump/<id>.md or raw/sources/<id>/text.md

model.description: The model that answered, as Jev reports it, or null when Jev was not reached and every label was held

line.description: The triage-accept line the run used: a label is sure at or above it, or at or below one minus it

key.description: The question's key in the Jev request, such as kind:idea, venture:f1:acme-labs or function:f1:finance

p.description: The answer: a Noul's probability of yes, or a Score; null when not answered

sure.description: Whether the answer cleared the line. A Score is never a filing decision, so it is always true

person.description: A person's answer, when one was given for a held label

filed.description: What the run wrote, as venture paths (an idea, a reference)

held.description: The keys of labels held for a person

to_person.description: Whether the routed work goes to a person because the entry may be a one-way door

status.description: filed: every label was sure. held: waiting on a person. answered: a person answered the held labels and the run filed
